Aatrox.name: Aatrox
Aatrox.title: the Darkin Blade
Aatrox.play: Hit the edges of your Q (sweet spots). Your ult makes you heal a lot, fight inside it.
Aatrox.vs: Step toward him or sideways when he Qs — the sweet spot is at the tip. Buy anti-heal.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox ult = huge healing and revive-like fights. Anti-heal matters.

Ahri.name: Ahri
Ahri.title: the Nine-Tailed Fox
Ahri.play: Land your charm (E) then burst. Your ult has 3 dashes: use it to engage OR escape, not both.
Ahri.vs: Stay behind minions to block her charm. She is weak when her ult is down.
Ahri.watch: Ahri roams with ult — she can pick off side lanes out of nowhere.

Akali.name: Akali
Akali.title: the Rogue Assassin
Akali.play: Poke with Q, fight inside your smoke (W). Wait for level 6 to go all-in.
Akali.vs: Control wards / sweepers reveal her in smoke. Play safe after 6, she can dive you.
Akali.watch: Akali is invisible in her shroud and dives backline with 2 dashes.

Akshan.name: Akshan
Akshan.title: the Rogue Sentinel
Akshan.play: Poke with your double auto, swing with E around walls. Killing the guy who killed your ally revives them.
Akshan.vs: Stay out of vision, trade when his E is down.
Akshan.watch: If Akshan kills the enemy who killed his ally, that ally REVIVES.

Alistar.name: Alistar
Alistar.title: the Minotaur
Alistar.play: W (headbutt) then Q (knockup) is your combo. Your ult lets you tank everything, dive in.
Alistar.vs: Keep distance, he needs to get close for W+Q.
Alistar.watch: Alistar engages from far with W+Q combo and is very hard to kill with ult on.

Ambessa.name: Ambessa
Ambessa.title: Matriarch of War
Ambessa.play: Chain your abilities to dash between them. Ult to lock the backline carry.
Ambessa.vs: Short trades when her dashes are on cooldown.
Ambessa.watch: Ambessa ult blinks to the FARTHEST enemy in a line and suppresses them.

Amumu.name: Amumu
Amumu.title: the Sad Mummy
Amumu.play: Land Q (bandage) then ult in the middle of 3+ enemies.
Amumu.vs: Stay spread out in fights so his ult doesn't hit everyone.
Amumu.watch: Amumu ult stuns the whole team if you're grouped — spread out.

Anivia.name: Anivia
Anivia.title: the Cryophoenix
Anivia.play: Your egg revives you. Use your wall to split fights and block escapes.
Anivia.vs: All-in her before 6 and when her egg is down.
Anivia.watch: Anivia wall can block your escape path in fights.

Annie.name: Annie
Annie.title: the Dark Child
Annie.play: Every 4th spell stuns. Hold the stun, flash + ult for a big engage.
Annie.vs: Watch her stun counter (the white swirl around her). Stay away when it's ready.
Annie.watch: Annie can flash-ult a whole team with a stun. Stay spread.

Aphelios.name: Aphelios
Aphelios.title: the Weapon of the Faithful
Aphelios.play: Weak early, you scale hard. Learn which 2 guns you hold.
Aphelios.vs: Punish him early, he has no escape.
Aphelios.watch: Aphelios becomes a monster late with Crescendum. End early.

Ashe.name: Ashe
Ashe.title: the Frost Archer
Ashe.play: Slow them with your autos, ult (arrow) catches people from across the map.
Ashe.vs: Dodge her long-range arrow ult. Fight her up close.
Ashe.watch: Ashe arrow ult can stun you from off-screen. Her E reveals your jungle.

AurelionSol.name: Aurelion Sol
AurelionSol.title: The Star Forger
AurelionSol.play: Farm and stack. You're weak early, huge late.
AurelionSol.vs: Punish him hard before 6 — he is slow and fragile.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol late game = constant AoE damage. Don't let the game go long.

Aurora.name: Aurora
Aurora.title: the Witch Between Worlds
Aurora.play: Hop around with W and your ult zone. Poke with Q.
Aurora.vs: Hard CC catches her when her W is down.
Aurora.watch: Aurora ult zone lets her teleport around — fights inside it favor her.

Azir.name: Azir
Azir.title: the Emperor of the Sands
Azir.play: Soldiers do the damage, stay far back. Ult pushes enemies away (or into your team).
Azir.vs: Dive him — he's weak and slow if caught.
Azir.watch: Azir ult (shuffle) throws your carry into his team.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.title: the Wandering Caretaker
Bard.play: Roam and collect chimes. Q stuns if it hits 2 targets or a wall.
Bard.vs: He leaves lane a lot — push and punish his ADC alone.
Bard.watch: Bard ult freezes everything (including your team) — don't panic, wait it out.

Belveth.name: Bel'Veth
Belveth.title: the Empress of the Void
Belveth.play: Farm and scale. Take void coral from epic monsters.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth snowballs off objectives — contest Rift Herald / Baron.

Blitzcrank.name: Blitzcrank
Blitzcrank.title: the Great Steam Golem
Blitzcrank.play: Hide in bush, pull the enemy carry (Q) into your team.
Blitzcrank.vs: Stay behind minions. Never face-check bushes.
Blitzcrank.watch: Blitzcrank hook from a bush = instant death for squishies. Walk behind minions.

Brand.name: Brand
Brand.title: the Burning Vengeance
Brand.play: Land 3 spells to trigger the burn explosion. Great in teamfights.
Brand.vs: He's immobile and fragile — engage on him.
Brand.watch: Brand melts tanks with % health burn.

Braum.name: Braum
Braum.title: the Heart of the Freljord
Braum.play: Stand in front of your ADC, block with E (shield). 4 hits = stun.
Braum.vs: Don't walk into his 4th stun stack.
Braum.watch: Braum shield (E) blocks projectiles — spells like Ashe arrow won't pass.

Briar.name: Briar
Briar.title: the Restrained Hunger
Briar.play: W goes berserk — you can't control it well. Dive, heal, repeat.
Briar.vs: CC her when she's berserk, she can't escape.
Briar.watch: Briar is healthy early — her ganks come fast at level 3.

Caitlyn.name: Caitlyn
Caitlyn.title: the Sheriff of Piltover
Caitlyn.play: Poke with long range and traps. Headshot every few autos.
Caitlyn.vs: Get close, she hates being dived. Don't stand on her traps.
Caitlyn.watch: Caitlyn ult snipes low HP targets from far.

Camille.name: Camille
Camille.title: the Steel Shadow
Camille.play: Hookshot (E) off walls to engage. Ult locks one target.
Camille.vs: Stand away from walls and trade when her E is down.
Camille.watch: Camille ult isolates a carry — nobody else can help them.

Cassiopeia.name: Cassiopeia
Cassiopeia.title: the Serpent's Embrace
Cassiopeia.play: E spam is your damage. Face enemies with ult to stun.
Cassiopeia.vs: Look AWAY from her ult (turn your camera/movement) to not get stunned.
Cassiopeia.watch: Cassiopeia ult stuns if you're facing her. Walk away from her, not toward.

Chogath.name: Cho'Gath
Chogath.title: the Terror of the Void
Chogath.play: Eat (ult) to get bigger. Q is your knockup.
Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath ult is true damage execute on low HP targets.

Corki.name: Corki
Corki.title: the Daring Bombardier
Corki.play: Poke with rockets. Pick the package every few minutes.
Corki.vs: All-in him when his W (dash) is down.
Corki.watch: Corki package lets him fly into your backline.

Darius.name: Darius
Darius.title: the Hand of Noxus
Darius.play: Stack 5 bleeds and ult to reset. Hit the edge of your Q to heal.
Darius.vs: DO NOT fight him at 5 stacks. Poke him from range.
Darius.watch: Darius ult resets on kills — he can pentakill if your team is low.

Diana.name: Diana
Diana.title: Scorn of the Moon
Diana.play: Q then R for a big AoE engage.
Diana.vs: Stay spread out to limit her ult pull.
Diana.watch: Diana ult pulls everyone nearby — group less.

Draven.name: Draven
Draven.title: the Glorious Executioner
Draven.play: Catch your spinning axes. You're strongest early.
Draven.vs: Play safe early, he's a lane bully. Make him fall off.
Draven.watch: Draven can snowball fast — deny his early kills.

DrMundo.name: Dr. Mundo
DrMundo.title: the Madman of Zaun
DrMundo.play: Farm with Q cleaver, you're a tank that heals tons.
DrMundo.vs: Buy anti-heal. Poke him before he gets big.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo ult heals him massively — anti-heal is a must.

Ekko.name: Ekko
Ekko.title: the Boy Who Shattered Time
Ekko.play: Your ult rewinds you — engage, burst, ult back.
Ekko.vs: Burst him before he can ult.
Ekko.watch: Ekko ult rewinds him to safety with heal — kill him fast or not at all.

Elise.name: Elise
Elise.title: the Spider Queen
Elise.vs: Ward early, she's a strong early ganker.
Elise.watch: Elise ganks early and often. Ward your river at level 3.

Evelynn.name: Evelynn
Evelynn.title: Agony's Embrace
Evelynn.play: Invisible from level 6. Charm then burst.
Evelynn.vs: Control wards reveal her. Play near your team after 6.
Evelynn.watch: Evelynn is invisible from level 6 — carry a control ward.

Ezreal.name: Ezreal
Ezreal.title: the Prodigal Explorer
Ezreal.play: Land your Q poke, E (blink) is your escape.
Ezreal.vs: All-in when his E (blink) is down.
Ezreal.watch: Ezreal ult is a global beam — careful when low.

Fiddlesticks.name: Fiddlesticks
Fiddlesticks.title: the Ancient Fear
Fiddlesticks.play: Hide in fog, ult into their team from brush.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks ult from a bush wipes teams. Ward around objectives.

Fiora.name: Fiora
Fiora.title: the Grand Duelist
Fiora.play: Hit the vitals (the small X marks) to heal and win duels.
Fiora.watch: Fiora ult heals her team if she hits 4 vitals. She'll split push.

Fizz.name: Fizz
Fizz.title: the Tidal Trickster
Fizz.play: E (hop) dodges everything. Fish ult then all-in.
Fizz.vs: Save your burst for after his E hop.
Fizz.watch: Fizz shark ult bursts carries — his E dodges your skillshots.

Galio.name: Galio
Galio.title: the Colossus
Galio.play: Tank magic damage, taunt with E, ult to join any fight.
Galio.vs: Push his wave so he can't roam.
Galio.watch: Galio ult flies him to any teammate's fight across the map.

Gangplank.name: Gangplank
Gangplank.title: the Saltwater Scourge
Gangplank.play: Barrel combos. Your ult is global.
Gangplank.vs: Go aggressive early, he's weak before items.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank ult hits anywhere on the map.

Garen.name: Garen
Garen.title: The Might of Demacia
Garen.play: Q then spin (E). Ult executes low HP targets.
Garen.vs: Poke him, don't let him spin on you.
Garen.watch: Garen ult is true damage execute.

Gnar.name: Gnar
Gnar.title: the Missing Link
Gnar.play: Mini form is poke, Mega form stuns. Plan fights for Mega Gnar.
Gnar.watch: Mega Gnar ult throws you into walls — stay out of walls when he's big.

Gragas.name: Gragas
Gragas.title: the Rabble Rouser
Gragas.play: Body slam (E) to stun, ult to push enemies.
Gragas.vs: Dodge his E and stay out of barrel range.
Gragas.watch: Gragas ult can push your carry into his team.

Graves.name: Graves
Graves.title: the Outlaw
Graves.play: Short-range shotgun. Clear fast and invade.
Graves.watch: Graves takes your jungle camps — ward your jungle.

Gwen.name: Gwen
Gwen.title: The Hallowed Seamstress
Gwen.play: Stand in W mist to block ranged hits. Scale up.
Gwen.vs: Walk into her mist to hit her. Short trades.
Gwen.watch: Gwen mist makes her untargetable from outside — walk in.

Hecarim.name: Hecarim
Hecarim.title: the Shadow of War
Hecarim.play: Run fast, charge (E) knocks back. Ult fears.
Hecarim.vs: Hard CC stops him. Ward river.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim runs in super fast from fog — ward the sides of fights.

Heimerdinger.name: Heimerdinger
Heimerdinger.title: the Revered Inventor
Heimerdinger.play: Turrets on your lane. Siege and poke.
Heimerdinger.vs: Dive him when turrets are down.
Heimerdinger.watch: Heimerdinger turrets make fighting near him painful.

Hwei.name: Hwei
Hwei.title: the Visionary
Hwei.play: 10 spells. Poke from max range, CC with the E line.
Hwei.watch: Hwei can poke and control fights from very far.

Illaoi.name: Illaoi
Illaoi.title: the Kraken Priestess
Illaoi.play: Fight near your tentacles. Hit spirit with E.
Illaoi.vs: Dodge her E (spirit grab). Never fight her during ult.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi ult = don't fight her in that area, walk away.

Irelia.name: Irelia
Irelia.title: the Blade Dancer
Irelia.play: Stack passive, Q resets on marked targets.
Irelia.vs: Fight her when passive is down.
Irelia.watch: Irelia jumps from minion to minion in fights — hard to escape.

Janna.name: Janna
Janna.title: the Storm's Fury
Janna.play: Disengage. Tornado + knockback. Ult pushes enemies away and heals.
Janna.vs: Engage when her ult/knockback is down.
Janna.watch: Janna ult cancels your engage by knocking everyone back.

JarvanIV.name: Jarvan IV
JarvanIV.title: the Exemplar of Demacia
JarvanIV.play: E (flag) + Q = knockup combo. Ult traps.
JarvanIV.watch: Jarvan ult traps your team in a ring — Flash out.

Jax.name: Jax
Jax.title: Grandmaster at Arms
Jax.vs: Poppy/Malphite. Don't auto during his E.

Jayce.name: Jayce
Jayce.title: the Defender of Tomorrow
Jayce.play: Poke with Q through E gate.
Jayce.vs: All-in him, he's weak without poke.
Jayce.watch: Jayce poke can shred your team before fights.

Jhin.name: Jhin
Jhin.title: the Virtuoso
Jhin.play: 4 shots, 4th crits. W roots slowed targets.
Jhin.watch: Jhin ult snipes from far away.

Jinx.name: Jinx
Jinx.title: the Loose Cannon
Jinx.play: Stay back. Rocket + minigun swap. Resets on kills.
Jinx.vs: Dive her — she has no escape.
Jinx.watch: Jinx ult is global execute. Late game she deletes teams.

Kaisa.name: Kai'Sa
Kaisa.title: Daughter of the Void
Kaisa.play: Evolve abilities at item points. Ult dashes to marked target.
Kaisa.vs: CC her when she jumps in.
Kaisa.watch: Kai'Sa ult dives your backline — keep peel.

Kalista.name: Kalista
Kalista.title: the Spear of Vengeance
Kalista.play: Hop after each attack. Ult saves your support.
Kalista.vs: Slow her. Fight when her ult is down.
Kalista.watch: Kalista ult throws her support into your team.

Karma.name: Karma
Karma.title: the Enlightened One
Karma.play: Poke with empowered Q. Shield (E) your team.
Karma.watch: Karma speed-shield can make her team engage fast.

Karthus.name: Karthus
Karthus.title: the Deathsinger
Karthus.play: Farm, you're strong late. Ult hits the whole map.
Karthus.watch: Karthus ult hits EVERYONE on the map. Stay above 30% HP.

Kassadin.name: Kassadin
Kassadin.title: the Void Walker
Kassadin.vs: Kill him early — he's super weak before 6.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin late game teleports onto your carry every few seconds.

Katarina.name: Katarina
Katarina.title: the Sinister Blade
Katarina.play: Pick up daggers. Resets on kills.
Katarina.watch: Katarina ult spins — CC her immediately to stop it.

Kayle.name: Kayle
Kayle.title: the Righteous
Kayle.vs: Kill her early before she scales.
Kayle.watch: Kayle ult makes an ally invulnerable.

Kayn.name: Kayn
Kayn.title: the Shadow Reaper
Kayn.play: Pick red (Rhaast) or blue (Shadow Assassin) form.
Kayn.watch: Kayn goes through walls. Ward your jungle entrances.

Kennen.name: Kennen
Kennen.title: the Heart of the Tempest
Kennen.play: 3 stacks stun. Ult in their team.
Kennen.vs: Dodge his Q, fight him with sustain.
Kennen.watch: Kennen flash ult stuns the whole team.

Khazix.name: Kha'Zix
Khazix.title: the Voidreaver
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix kills isolated targets — never walk alone.

Kindred.name: Kindred
Kindred.title: The Eternal Hunters
Kindred.watch: Kindred ult stops anyone from dying — wait it out.

Kled.name: Kled
Kled.title: the Cantankerous Cavalier
Kled.play: Rider/mount. Ult charges across the map.
Kled.watch: Kled ult charges across the map to start a fight.

KogMaw.name: Kog'Maw
KogMaw.title: the Mouth of the Abyss
KogMaw.play: Stay behind tanks. W shreds everything.
KogMaw.watch: Kog'Maw with peel melts tanks — focus him first.

KSante.name: K'Sante
KSante.title: the Pride of Nazumah
KSante.watch: K'Sante ult throws your carry out of the fight.

Leblanc.name: LeBlanc
Leblanc.title: the Deceiver
Leblanc.play: W (dash) in, burst, press W again to go back. Wait for them to use their key spell, then jump.
Leblanc.vs: Stay near your minions and keep your stun/root for when she dashes in — she's fragile once caught.
Leblanc.watch: LeBlanc bursts squishies from fog — her ult clone copies her to fool you.

LeeSin.name: Lee Sin
LeeSin.title: the Blind Monk
LeeSin.play: Q (sonic wave) then Q again to dash in. Kick (R) the enemy carry into your team. Strongest early — gank a lot.
LeeSin.vs: Ward your jungle and river early, he invades and ganks from level 3. He falls off late.
LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin can kick your carry into his team — keep distance from him.

Leona.name: Leona
Leona.title: the Radiant Dawn
Leona.play: E dashes you in, Q stuns, then your team follows. Ult is a big AoE stun. Engage when your ADC is ready.
Leona.vs: Stay behind minions and out of her E range (~875). Don't stand next to your ADC — her ult hits both.
Leona.watch: Leona locks you down for 3+ seconds — stay spread out.

Lillia.name: Lillia
Lillia.title: the Bashful Bloom
Lillia.play: Hit the outer edge of Q for bonus damage. Run around fights, stack your passive. Ult puts poked enemies to sleep.
Lillia.vs: Burst her fast — she's strong if the fight lasts. Don't get poked before fights.
Lillia.watch: Lillia ult puts everyone she poked to SLEEP — damage wakes them.

Lissandra.name: Lissandra
Lissandra.title: the Ice Witch
Lissandra.play: Claw (E) then recast to jump in. Ult an enemy to freeze them, or yourself to survive.
Lissandra.vs: Poke her, she's short range. Stay spread so her W root doesn't catch 2.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra can ult herself to become untargetable for a few seconds.

Locke.name: Locke
Locke.title: the Ashen Exorcist
Locke.play: Mark with Q, dash in with E, finish low targets with ult. W (ignite yourself) = speed but costs HP.
Locke.vs: Save CC for when he dashes in. Group with your team — he wants lone targets.
Locke.watch: Locke ult can EXECUTE low HP targets — don't stay low near him.

Lucian.name: Lucian
Lucian.title: the Purifier
Lucian.play: After each spell, you shoot twice — weave spells between autos. Very strong early with an aggressive support.
Lucian.vs: Play safe levels 2-6 — he's strongest early. Trade when his E (dash) is down.
Lucian.watch: Lucian with an enchanter support bullies bot lane hard early.

Lulu.name: Lulu
Lulu.title: the Fae Sorceress
Lulu.play: Shield (E) and speed up (W) your carry. Ult makes them huge and knocks enemies up. Keep your carry alive.
Lulu.vs: Engage on HER, she's the squishy one. Her W can turn you into a critter — wait for it to be down.
Lulu.watch: Lulu ult saves her carry at the last second and knocks you up.

Lux.name: Lux
Lux.title: the Lady of Luminosity
Lux.play: Poke with E, land Q (roots 2 people), ult from max range after a root. Shield your ADC with W.
Lux.vs: Dodge sideways. She's immobile, so if her Q (root) misses, go in.
Lux.watch: Lux ult hits from very far — don't stand in a straight line when low.

Malphite.name: Malphite
Malphite.title: Shard of the Monolith
Malphite.play: Farm safe with Q poke. Your ult is the game — land it on 3+ enemies and your team follows.
Malphite.vs: Poke him in lane and spread out in fights. He is weak against magic damage.
Malphite.watch: Malphite ult knocks up your whole team from fog. Spread out.

Malzahar.name: Malzahar
Malzahar.title: the Prophet of the Void
Malzahar.play: Push waves with voidlings and E. Ult suppresses one target — use it on their carry.
Malzahar.vs: Break his spell shield (passive) with a poke first, then trade.
Malzahar.watch: Malzahar ult locks your carry for 2.5 seconds — nobody can save them easily.

Maokai.name: Maokai
Maokai.title: the Twisted Treant
Maokai.play: W roots from range, Q knocks back. Throw saplings in bushes for vision. Ult is a long root wave.
Maokai.vs: Kite him, don't stand in bushes he threw saplings in.
Maokai.watch: Maokai ult roots in a long wave — dodge it by moving sideways.

MasterYi.name: Master Yi
MasterYi.title: the Wuju Bladesman
MasterYi.play: Farm fast, dodge key spells with Q. Resets on kills — clean up fights, don't start them.
MasterYi.vs: CC him. Hard CC (stun, suppress) stops him cold. Group with your team.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi resets on kills — save your stun for him.

Mel.name: Mel
Mel.title: the Soul's Reflection
Mel.play: Poke with Q. W reflects enemy projectiles back. Ult hits everyone you marked, anywhere.
Mel.vs: Don't throw skillshots into her W shield. All-in her when W is down.
Mel.watch: Mel W REFLECTS projectiles — careful with your skillshots.

Milio.name: Milio
Milio.title: The Gentle Flame
Milio.play: Heal and shield your carry, give them range with W. Ult removes CC from your team.
Milio.vs: Engage right after he uses his ult. He's weak when caught alone.
Milio.watch: Milio ult cleanses your team's CC — engage after he uses it.

MissFortune.name: Miss Fortune
MissFortune.title: the Bounty Hunter
MissFortune.play: Bounce Q off minions onto champs. Ult from a safe spot in a big fight — huge damage.
MissFortune.vs: Stand away from low HP minions (her Q bounces). Interrupt her ult with CC.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune ult melts grouped teams — interrupt her.

MonkeyKing.name: Wukong
MonkeyKing.title: the Monkey King
MonkeyKing.play: W makes a clone and you go invisible. Ult spins and knocks up twice — engage with it.
MonkeyKing.vs: Short trades when his W is down. Watch out for the fake clone.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong ult knocks up your team twice — spread out.

Mordekaiser.name: Mordekaiser
Mordekaiser.title: the Iron Revenant
Mordekaiser.play: Hit Q (the slam) with no enemy next to the target for bonus damage. Ult sends one enemy into your realm for a 1v1.
Mordekaiser.vs: Dodge his Q, don't fight in his passive (AoE damage) zone. Kite him.
Mordekaiser.watch: Mordekaiser ult isolates your carry for a 1v1 — nobody can help.

Morgana.name: Morgana
Morgana.title: the Fallen
Morgana.play: Land Q (long root) to catch people. Use E (black shield) on your ADC to block the enemy engage.
Morgana.vs: Stay behind minions — her Q is blocked by them.
Morgana.watch: Morgana Black Shield blocks CC — don't waste your engage on the shielded target.

Naafiri.name: Naafiri
Naafiri.title: the Hound of a Hundred Bites
Naafiri.play: Your dogs do the damage. Ult makes you fast — use it to catch someone.
Naafiri.vs: Stay near your team and your minions — she wants you alone.
Naafiri.watch: Naafiri bursts squishies fast out of nowhere.

Nami.name: Nami
Nami.title: the Tidecaller
Nami.play: Land bubble (Q) to stun, then your ADC follows. Heal with W. Buff ADC autos with E. Ult wave is a big knockup.
Nami.vs: Engage when her bubble is down. Dodge the bubble sideways.
Nami.watch: Nami ult wave can knock up your whole team.

Nasus.name: Nasus
Nasus.title: the Curator of the Sands
Nasus.play: Last hit minions with Q to stack it. Weak early, a monster late. Split push.
Nasus.vs: Punish him hard early before he stacks Q. Deny his last hits.
Nasus.watch: Nasus late = huge damage. End the game early.

Nautilus.name: Nautilus
Nautilus.title: the Titan of the Depths
Nautilus.play: Q (hook) to engage, root on your first auto, ult = point-and-click knockup. Fight when your ADC is close.
Nautilus.vs: Stay behind minions to block the hook. Don't stand next to walls (he can hook walls to escape).
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus ult is a guaranteed knockup on one target.

Neeko.name: Neeko
Neeko.title: the Curious Chameleon
Neeko.play: Disguise as a teammate with passive. Root with E, then ult jump for a big stun.
Neeko.vs: Watch for a teammate icon acting weird — that's Neeko. Dodge her E.
Neeko.watch: Neeko can disguise as a teammate — suspicious minions/allies may be her.

Nidalee.name: Nidalee
Nidalee.title: the Bestial Huntress
Nidalee.play: Throw spear (Q) at max range — it hurts more from far. Cougar form to chase.
Nidalee.vs: Dodge spears. Invade her early — she's weak if caught.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee spear from fog can one-shot squishies.

Nilah.name: Nilah
Nilah.title: the Joy Unbound
Nilah.play: Melee ADC. Farm safe, dash in with E, ult pulls everyone in.
Nilah.vs: Poke her a lot — she has to walk up to hit you.
Nilah.watch: Nilah ult pulls everyone in — spread out.

Nocturne.name: Nocturne
Nocturne.title: the Eternal Nightmare
Nocturne.play: After 6, ult darkens the whole map and you fly to a target. Pick squishies.
Nocturne.vs: Stay near allies after he hits 6. Keep your screen up when the map goes dark.
Nocturne.watch: Nocturne ult = map goes dark, he's coming for someone.

Nunu.name: Nunu & Willump
Nunu.title: the Boy and His Yeti
Nunu.play: Roll a snowball (W) to gank from far. Eat camps with Q. Ult is a huge slow zone.
Nunu.vs: Ward river. Walk out of his ult zone fast.
Nunu.watch: Nunu snowball comes from far — ward river.

Olaf.name: Olaf
Olaf.title: the Berserker
Olaf.play: Throw axes and pick them up. Ult makes you immune to CC — run straight at their carry.
Olaf.vs: Kite him, he's strongest early. Don't waste CC during his ult.
Olaf.watch: Olaf ult ignores all CC — don't waste your stun.

Orianna.name: Orianna
Orianna.title: the Lady of Clockwork
Orianna.play: Move the ball with Q, shield an ally with E (the ball goes with it). Ult pulls enemies around the ball.
Orianna.vs: Watch where the ball is. Dive her when her E shield is on someone else.
Orianna.watch: Orianna ult pulls your team together — stay away from the ball.

Ornn.name: Ornn
Ornn.title: The Fire below the Mountain
Ornn.play: Tank. Upgrades your team's items at level 13+. Ult ram knocks up.
Ornn.vs: Poke him, don't stand next to his pillars (walls).
Ornn.watch: Ornn ult knocks up your team — watch for the big ram coming back.

Pantheon.name: Pantheon
Pantheon.title: the Unbreakable Spear
Pantheon.play: Early fighter — harass with Q, stun with W. Ult drops onto another lane to gank.
Pantheon.vs: Play safe early, he's very strong levels 1-6. He falls off late.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon ult drops in from the sky onto a lane.

Poppy.name: Poppy
Poppy.title: Keeper of the Hammer
Poppy.play: E dashes an enemy into a wall = stun. W stops all dashes nearby.
Poppy.watch: Poppy W stops dashes — don't dash near her.

Pyke.name: Pyke
Pyke.title: the Bloodharbor Ripper
Pyke.play: Hook (Q) and stun (E). Ult executes low HP targets and gives your team gold.
Pyke.vs: Stay healthy — his ult executes when you're low. Don't chase him into fog.
Pyke.watch: Pyke ult executes low HP targets and gives gold to his team.

Qiyana.name: Qiyana
Qiyana.title: Empress of the Elements
Qiyana.play: Grab an element (grass = invisible, rock = bonus damage, water = root). Ult near walls stuns.
Qiyana.vs: Stay away from walls and rivers when she's around.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana ult near walls stuns your whole team.

Quinn.name: Quinn
Quinn.title: Demacia's Wings
Quinn.play: Blind with Q, vault off with E. Ult to roam super fast.
Quinn.vs: Engage when her E is down. She's squishy.
Quinn.watch: Quinn roams fast with her ult — track her.

Rakan.name: Rakan
Rakan.title: The Charmer
Rakan.play: Engage with W (knockup) then ult to charm. E dashes to allies to save them.
Rakan.vs: CC him early in his combo. Stand spread out.
Rakan.watch: Rakan ult charms your whole team — spread out.

Rammus.name: Rammus
Rammus.title: the Armordillo
Rammus.play: Roll in with Q, taunt with E. Great vs auto attackers.
Rammus.vs: Magic damage beats him — don't auto him while his W is up.
Rammus.watch: Rammus taunt forces your carries to walk into him.

RekSai.name: Rek'Sai
RekSai.title: the Void Burrower
RekSai.play: Tunnel around, unburrow for a knockup. Ult dashes to low HP targets.
RekSai.vs: Ward — she senses you even without vision when you move.
RekSai.watch: Rek'Sai ult dashes to a low HP target from far.

Rell.name: Rell
Rell.title: the Iron Maiden
Rell.play: Engage with W (knockup), E links to an ally, ult pulls everyone in.
Rell.vs: Spread out, stay far from her when she dismounts.
Rell.watch: Rell ult pulls your team together — spread out.

Renata.name: Renata Glasc
Renata.title: the Chem-Baroness
Renata.play: Q grabs and throws. W saves an ally from death. Ult makes enemies attack each other.
Renata.vs: Engage when her ult is down.
Renata.watch: Renata ult makes YOUR team fight each other.

Renekton.name: Renekton
Renekton.title: the Butcher of the Sands
Renekton.play: Very strong early. Use fury (the bar) for empowered spells. Dash in and out with E.
Renekton.vs: Play safe early, he falls off later.
Renekton.watch: Renekton's early game is scary — don't fight him early.

Rengar.name: Rengar
Rengar.title: the Pridestalker
Rengar.play: Jump from bushes. Ult makes you invisible to hunt someone.
Rengar.watch: Rengar ult = he's invisible and coming for someone.

Riven.name: Riven
Riven.title: the Exile
Riven.play: Q three times to dash in, E shields, W stuns. Ult = more damage + execute wave.
Riven.vs: Short trades when her Q is down.
Riven.watch: Riven ult executes low HP targets.

Rumble.name: Rumble
Rumble.title: the Mechanized Menace
Rumble.play: Keep your heat between 50 and 100 (danger zone) for bonus damage, but don't overheat. Flamethrower (Q) is your main damage. Ult = a line of fire.
Rumble.vs: Trade when he overheats (he can't cast for a few seconds). Stay out of his Q cone.
Rumble.watch: Rumble ult is a long fire zone that slows — walk out of it sideways.

Ryze.name: Ryze
Ryze.title: the Rune Mage
Ryze.play: Chain Q between your other spells for damage. E spreads to nearby enemies. Ult teleports your whole team.
Ryze.vs: All-in him early, he's weak before 2 items and has no dash.
Ryze.watch: Ryze ult teleports his whole team for surprise fights.

Samira.name: Samira
Samira.title: the Desert Rose
Samira.play: Mix autos and spells to build your style grade to S, then ult. W blocks projectiles. Wait for your support to engage, then dash in.
Samira.vs: Play safe early and CC her the moment she jumps in — it cancels her ult.
Samira.watch: Samira ult spins and shreds everyone — CC her immediately.

Sejuani.name: Sejuani
Sejuani.title: Fury of the North
Sejuani.play: Engage with Q (dash) or ult. E stuns once your melee allies hit the target — great with melee teammates.
Sejuani.vs: Kite her and fight away from her melee allies. Dodge her ult.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani ult stuns a big area around the target.

Senna.name: Senna
Senna.title: the Redeemer
Senna.play: Collect souls from dead enemies/minions to scale forever. Q heals allies and damages enemies. W roots.
Senna.vs: Engage her early — she's slow and squishy before souls stack.
Senna.watch: Senna ult is GLOBAL — it shields her team and hits yours across the map.

Seraphine.name: Seraphine
Seraphine.title: the Starry-Eyed Songstress
Seraphine.play: Every 3rd spell is doubled. Use W to shield and heal your team in fights. Ult charms and gets longer through allies.
Seraphine.vs: Engage on her, she has no escape. Don't stand in a line with teammates.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine ult charms your team if you're lined up.

Sett.name: Sett
Sett.title: the Boss
Sett.play: Punch punch. W absorbs damage then deals TRUE damage in the middle of the blast. Ult slams a target onto their team.
Sett.vs: Poke him from range. Dodge the middle of his W by stepping sideways.
Sett.watch: Sett W center hits hard — sidestep it.

Shaco.name: Shaco
Shaco.title: the Demon Jester
Shaco.play: Q to go invisible and backstab. Place boxes (W) in bushes — they fear. Ult clone confuses.
Shaco.vs: Buy control wards — they reveal his boxes and him. Walk around boxes.
Shaco.watch: Shaco boxes fear you — careful near bushes and in his jungle.

Shen.name: Shen
Shen.title: the Eye of Twilight
Shen.play: Tank. E dashes and taunts. W blocks autos. Ult shields a teammate anywhere on the map and teleports you to them.
Shen.vs: Poke him when his E is down, he doesn't do much damage. Push your wave when he ults away.
Shen.watch: Careful, Shen might randomly pull up bot lane with ult.

Shyvana.name: Shyvana
Shyvana.title: the Half-Dragon
Shyvana.play: Farm fast and collect dragon marks. Ult turns you into a dragon that flies into the fight.
Shyvana.vs: Invade her early and kite her.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana dragon form flies into fights from far.

Singed.name: Singed
Singed.title: the Mad Chemist
Singed.play: Run around with poison trail (Q). E flings enemies behind you. Proxy farm behind their tower.
Singed.vs: Never chase him into his poison. Push waves and let him run around.
Singed.watch: Singed proxy farms your waves — don't chase him into poison.

Sion.name: Sion
Sion.title: The Undead Juggernaut
Sion.play: Charge Q for a big knockup. W shield explodes. Ult charges across the map. You revive briefly on death.
Sion.vs: Poke him, step out of his charged Q (the red cone).
Sion.watch: Sion ult charges in from far away — listen for the roar.

Sivir.name: Sivir
Sivir.title: the Battle Mistress
Sivir.play: Clear waves fast with Q and W. E blocks one enemy spell. Ult speeds your team up for engages.
Sivir.vs: Poke her when her E (spell shield) is down.
Sivir.watch: Sivir ult speeds her whole team — watch for sudden engages.

Skarner.name: Skarner
Skarner.title: the Primordial Sovereign
Skarner.play: Tank. Q grabs a rock to throw. Ult grabs up to 3 enemies and drags them.
Skarner.vs: Stay away from him in fights and dodge his ult.
Skarner.watch: Skarner ult drags your carry into his team.

Smolder.name: Smolder
Smolder.title: the Fiery Fledgling
Smolder.play: Last hit with Q to stack it — you get stronger forever. Farm safe early, you win late.
Smolder.vs: Punish him early before he stacks.
Smolder.watch: Smolder late = huge AoE damage and executes.

Sona.name: Sona
Sona.title: Maven of the Strings
Sona.play: Heal (W), speed (E), poke (Q). Your auto after a spell adds a bonus. Ult stuns in a line.
Sona.vs: Engage on her early — she's super weak at levels 1-3.
Sona.watch: Sona ult stuns your team in a line.

Soraka.name: Soraka
Soraka.title: the Starchild
Soraka.play: Hit Q to heal yourself, then W to heal allies. E silences. Ult heals your team anywhere on the map.
Soraka.vs: Engage on her, she has no escape. Anti-heal helps a lot.
Soraka.watch: Soraka ult heals her whole team anywhere on the map.

Swain.name: Swain
Swain.title: the Noxian Grand General
Swain.play: E pulls and roots. Ult drains HP from everyone nearby and heals you.
Swain.vs: Poke him from range, don't fight inside his ult.
Swain.watch: Swain ult drains your team — back off instead of fighting in it.

Sylas.name: Sylas
Sylas.title: the Unshackled
Sylas.play: E chains an enemy and pulls you in. W heals more when you're low. Ult steals the best enemy ult.
Sylas.vs: Poke him, save your CC for when he chains in.
Sylas.watch: Sylas STEALS one of your team's ults and uses it against you.

Syndra.name: Syndra
Syndra.title: the Dark Sovereign
Syndra.play: Place balls with Q, then E pushes them into a stun. Ult throws all balls — huge burst.
Syndra.vs: Dodge her E stun (it goes out in a cone). Engage when E is down.

TahmKench.name: Tahm Kench
TahmKench.title: The River King
TahmKench.play: Q stacks, 3 stacks = stun. W travels far. Ult eats an ally to save them, or an enemy to drag them.
TahmKench.vs: Poke him from range, don't let him stack 3 on you.
TahmKench.watch: Tahm Kench can swallow his carry to save them.

Taliyah.name: Taliyah
Taliyah.title: the Stoneweaver
Taliyah.play: Q poke from range, W then E for a knockup combo. Ult is a huge wall you ride to roam fast.
Taliyah.vs: Roam when she roams. Dodge her W knockup.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah wall ult can cut your team in half.

Talon.name: Talon
Talon.title: the Blade's Shadow
Talon.play: Jump walls with E to roam. W + Q + ult = burst. Roam a lot, you're strongest early-mid.
Talon.vs: Stay near your tower and ping when he's missing.
Talon.watch: Talon roams over walls — track his location.

Taric.name: Taric
Taric.title: the Shield of Valoran
Taric.play: E stuns (also from your linked ally with W). Ult makes your team invulnerable after a 2.5s delay.
Taric.vs: Engage when his ult is down.
Taric.watch: Taric ult makes his team invulnerable — back off until it ends.

Teemo.name: Teemo
Teemo.title: the Swift Scout
Teemo.play: Blind (Q) melee champs. Place shrooms (R) in bushes and paths. Stay at range.
Teemo.vs: Buy sweepers (Oracle Lens). Jump on him when his blind is down.
Teemo.watch: Teemo shrooms everywhere — clear them with sweepers.

Thresh.name: Thresh
Thresh.title: the Chain Warden
Thresh.play: Hook (Q) and follow up. Lantern (W) saves allies — throw it to them. E pushes or pulls.
Thresh.vs: Stay behind minions. If he hooks your ADC, stay close so you can punish.
Thresh.watch: Thresh lantern pulls his teammates to safety.

Tristana.name: Tristana
Tristana.title: the Yordle Gunner
Tristana.play: Jump in (W), let your bomb (E) explode, jump out. Ult pushes enemies away.
Tristana.vs: Punish her jump — CC her when she lands.
Tristana.watch: Tristana jump resets on kills — she can chain jumps.

Trundle.name: Trundle
Trundle.title: the Troll King
Trundle.play: Pillar (E) blocks escape paths. Ult steals stats from the enemy tank. Q lowers their damage.
Trundle.watch: Trundle ult steals your tank's stats.

Tryndamere.name: Tryndamere
Tryndamere.title: the Barbarian King
Tryndamere.play: Crit a lot. Ult prevents death for 5 seconds. Split push side lanes.
Tryndamere.vs: Stun him before his ult. During his ult, back off — he can't die.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere can't die for 5 seconds with ult — wait it out.

TwistedFate.name: Twisted Fate
TwistedFate.title: the Card Master
TwistedFate.play: Pick gold card (W) to stun. Ult reveals everyone, then teleports you anywhere to gank.
TwistedFate.vs: Push his wave so he can't roam. Ping when he's missing.
TwistedFate.watch: Twisted Fate teleports to any lane with ult — watch for ganks.

Twitch.name: Twitch
Twitch.title: the Plague Rat
Twitch.play: Invisible with Q, ambush from bushes. Autos poison, E explodes the poison. Ult pierces through everyone.
Twitch.vs: Control wards reveal him. He's weak in lane.
Twitch.watch: Twitch is invisible and ambushes from bushes.

Udyr.name: Udyr
Udyr.title: the Spirit Walker
Udyr.play: Swap stances. Bear (E) runs fast and stuns. Clear the jungle fast and gank.
Udyr.vs: Kite him — he has to walk up to you.
Udyr.watch: Udyr runs at you fast and stuns.

Urgot.name: Urgot
Urgot.title: the Dreadnought
Urgot.play: Your legs shoot shotguns. W is a machine gun. E flips enemies over you. Ult executes low HP targets and fears.
Urgot.vs: Poke him, don't fight close to him.
Urgot.watch: Urgot ult executes and fears the whole team.

Varus.name: Varus
Varus.title: the Arrow of Retribution
Varus.play: Charge Q for long-range poke. Ult roots and spreads roots to nearby enemies.
Varus.vs: Spread out, dodge his charged Q (it's slow).
Varus.watch: Varus ult spreads roots between your team.

Vayne.name: Vayne
Vayne.title: the Night Hunter
Vayne.play: Tumble (Q) around. E pushes enemies into walls = stun. Every 3rd hit = true damage. Weak early, farm.
Vayne.vs: Punish her early — she's weak in lane.
Vayne.watch: Vayne goes invisible during her ult late game.

Veigar.name: Veigar
Veigar.title: the Tiny Master of Evil
Veigar.play: Last hit with Q to stack power forever. E cage stuns anyone who touches the edge. Ult bursts.
Veigar.vs: Dodge the cage edge. All-in when E is down.
Veigar.watch: Veigar cage stuns anyone who walks through its edge.

Velkoz.name: Vel'Koz
Velkoz.title: the Eye of the Void
Velkoz.play: Split Q at an angle to hit people. W is a big poke. Ult is a laser.
Velkoz.vs: Dive him — he's immobile. Dodge his split Q.
Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz true damage laser melts tanks.

Vex.name: Vex
Vex.title: the Gloomist
Vex.play: Your passive fears anyone who dashes near you. Ult dashes and resets on kill.
Vex.vs: Don't dash near her when her passive (dark cloud) is ready.
Vex.watch: Vex fears anyone who dashes near her.

Vi.name: Vi
Vi.title: the Piltover Enforcer
Vi.play: Charge Q to dash in. Ult locks a target — nothing can stop it.
Vi.vs: Stay near allies. Dodge her charged Q sideways.
Vi.watch: Vi ult locks your carry — it can't be stopped.

Viego.name: Viego
Viego.title: The Ruined King
Viego.play: Kill someone, then possess their body to use their spells. Clean up fights.
Viego.vs: Group and kill the possessed body fast.
Viego.watch: Viego possesses dead enemies and uses their abilities.

Viktor.name: Viktor
Viktor.title: the Herald of the Arcane
Viktor.play: Laser (E) poke, gravity field (W) stuns, ult storm follows enemies. Scale up.
Viktor.watch: Viktor gravity field stuns if you stay in it.

Vladimir.name: Vladimir
Vladimir.title: the Crimson Reaper
Vladimir.play: Heal off Q. W (pool) dodges everything. Scale up — you're strong late.

Volibear.name: Volibear
Volibear.title: the Relentless Storm
Volibear.play: Q runs fast and stuns, W bites. Ult jumps in and disables towers.
Volibear.vs: Kite him, don't fight him early.
Volibear.watch: Volibear ult disables your towers — he can dive you under them.

Warwick.name: Warwick
Warwick.title: the Uncaged Wrath of Zaun
Warwick.play: Smell low HP enemies and run fast to them. Ult jumps and suppresses.
Warwick.vs: Stay healthy — he gets stronger on low HP targets.
Warwick.watch: Warwick hunts low HP targets across the map.

Xayah.name: Xayah
Xayah.title: the Rebel
Xayah.play: Throw feathers, pull them back with E to root. Ult makes you untargetable briefly.
Xayah.vs: Engage her after her ult is used.
Xayah.watch: Xayah ult makes her untargetable — your big spell can miss.

Xerath.name: Xerath
Xerath.title: the Magus Ascendant
Xerath.play: Long-range poke with Q and W. Ult snipes from very far. Stay far back.
Xerath.watch: Xerath ult snipes from very far — careful when low.

XinZhao.name: Xin Zhao
XinZhao.title: the Seneschal of Demacia
XinZhao.play: E charges in, Q 3rd hit knocks up, ult sweeps enemies away.
XinZhao.watch: Xin Zhao ult blocks ranged damage from outside.

Yasuo.name: Yasuo
Yasuo.title: the Unforgiven
Yasuo.play: Windwall (W) blocks projectiles. Ult after knockups (yours or your team's).
Yasuo.vs: Don't dash to him. Trade when his shield (passive) is down.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo windwall blocks projectiles — including ults.

Yone.name: Yone
Yone.title: the Unforgotten
Yone.play: E sends you out in spirit form, you snap back. Ult knocks up everyone in a line.
Yone.vs: Stay spread. Trade when his E is down.
Yone.watch: Yone ult knocks up everyone in a line.

Yorick.name: Yorick
Yorick.title: Shepherd of Souls
Yorick.play: Ghouls and the maiden (ult) push lanes for you. Split push.
Yorick.vs: Kill his ghouls first, don't fight in his wall (E).
Yorick.watch: Yorick split pushes with his maiden — towers fall fast.

Yunara.name: Yunara
Yunara.title: the Unbroken Faith
Yunara.play: Stack attack speed, ult upgrades your abilities for a burst window. Farm safe early.
Yunara.watch: Yunara spreads her attacks to everyone near the target.

Yuumi.name: Yuumi
Yuumi.title: the Magical Cat
Yuumi.play: Attach to an ally, heal and shield them.
Yuumi.vs: Punish her ally — Yuumi can't do much alone.
Yuumi.watch: Yuumi makes her carry very hard to kill.

Zaahen.name: Zaahen
Zaahen.title: The Unsundered
Zaahen.play: Stack Determination by fighting, then all-in with knockup Q. You get stronger as the fight goes.
Zaahen.vs: Poke him before he stacks up.
Zaahen.watch: Zaahen gets stronger the longer a fight lasts — burst him fast.

Zac.name: Zac
Zac.title: the Secret Weapon
Zac.play: Charge E to jump from very far. Pick up your blobs to heal.
Zac.vs: Step on his blobs to deny his healing.
Zac.watch: Zac jumps in from fog from very far.

Zed.name: Zed
Zed.title: the Master of Shadows
Zed.play: Shadows (W) then burst. Ult marks a target, it explodes.
Zed.vs: Stay near your tower when he hits 6. Zhonya's is his hard counter.
Zed.watch: Zed ult deletes squishies — don't stay alone.

Zeri.name: Zeri
Zeri.title: The Spark of Zaun
Zeri.play: Run fast, kite around fights. Ult makes you super fast.
Zeri.watch: Zeri runs around the fight very fast.

Ziggs.name: Ziggs
Ziggs.title: the Hexplosives Expert
Ziggs.play: Siege towers with W. Bombs from far. Ult hits a big area.
Ziggs.watch: Ziggs ult hits from far — spread out.

Zilean.name: Zilean
Zilean.title: the Chronokeeper
Zilean.play: Two bombs on a target = stun. E speeds allies or slows enemies. Ult revives an ally once.
Zilean.watch: Zilean ult REVIVES his ally — expect it.

Zoe.name: Zoe
Zoe.title: the Aspect of Twilight
Zoe.play: Sleep bubble (E), then big Q from far away.
Zoe.vs: Dodge the bubble — stay behind minions.
Zoe.watch: Zoe bubble puts you to sleep — then big damage.

Zyra.name: Zyra
Zyra.title: Rise of the Thorns
Zyra.play: Plants help you poke and fight. E roots. Ult knocks everyone up.
Zyra.watch: Zyra ult knocks up your team.

items.name: Zhonya's Hourglass
items.answer: Active: freezes you in place — you can't act, but you can't be hurt either

items.name: Guardian Angel
items.answer: Brings you back to life once after you die

items.name: Banshee's Veil
items.answer: Blocks the next enemy spell that hits you

items.name: Mercurial Scimitar
items.answer: Active: removes stuns, roots and slows from yourself

items.name: Mikael's Blessing
items.answer: Active: removes crowd control from an ally

items.name: Mortal Reminder
items.answer: Your physical damage cuts enemy healing

items.name: Morellonomicon
items.answer: Your magic damage cuts enemy healing

items.name: Thornmail
items.answer: Hurts enemies who attack you and cuts their healing

items.name: Randuin's Omen
items.answer: You take less damage from critical strikes, and nearby enemies get slowed

items.name: Frozen Heart
items.answer: Nearby enemies attack slower

items.name: Lord Dominik's Regards
items.answer: Deals more damage to enemies with lots of bonus health

items.name: Void Staff
items.answer: Your magic damage ignores part of the enemy's magic resist

items.name: Black Cleaver
items.answer: Your physical hits shred the target's armor

items.name: Bloodletter's Curse
items.answer: Your spells shred the target's magic resist

items.name: Abyssal Mask
items.answer: Nearby enemies take more magic damage

items.name: Rabadon's Deathcap
items.answer: Greatly multiplies your ability power

items.name: Infinity Edge
items.answer: Makes your critical strikes hit much harder

items.name: Phantom Dancer
items.answer: Lets you walk through units while attacking fast

items.name: Youmuu's Ghostblade
items.answer: Makes you run much faster, especially out of combat

items.name: Sterak's Gage
items.answer: Gives you a big shield when you drop low

items.name: Maw of Malmortius
items.answer: Gives you a shield against magic damage when you drop low

items.name: Spirit Visage
items.answer: Makes heals and shields on you stronger

items.name: Warmog's Armor
items.answer: Regenerates your health fast when you're out of combat

items.name: Sunfire Aegis
items.answer: Burns enemies standing close to you

items.name: Heartsteel
items.answer: Charged hits on enemy champions make you permanently bigger and tankier

items.name: Dead Man's Plate
items.answer: Builds speed while you move, and your next hit slams harder

items.name: Knight's Vow
items.answer: You take part of the damage your chosen ally receives

items.name: Locket of the Iron Solari
items.answer: Active: shields all nearby allies

items.name: Redemption
items.answer: Active: heals allies in an area after a short delay, even from far away

items.name: Shurelya's Battlesong
items.answer: Active: speeds up nearby allies

items.name: Ardent Censer
items.answer: Your heals and shields make allies attack faster and harder

items.name: Moonstone Renewer
items.answer: Your heals and shields bounce to another ally
